title: Eurostat sdg_11_52: premature deaths due to PM2.5 exposure, Italy (annual, national)
summary: Eurostat SDG indicator 11.6.2-style table (dataset code sdg_11_52) giving annual premature deaths attributed to fine particulate matter (PM2.5) for Italy only (geo=IT), served as JSON-stat via the Eurostat dissemination API. The response has 36 cells: 18 years by two units (number and rate). It is national aggregate context, not station, traffic, clinic or district-level data. Last updated 2025-12-09 per the API metadata.

quality_notes: Coverage does not match the production window: data ends 2023 while the production window is 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31, so there are no production-period values.
Prototype window (2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04) overlaps only 2005 in this table; the 2004 year is outside the table.
The time index lists 2005, 2007 to 2023; 2006 is absent from the index, so the 18 values are not a continuous annual series.
Grain is annual, so it cannot meet any hourly need (N1-N3) or daily need (N4); it fits only N6 as national context.
Unit labels are NR (number) and RT (rate); the rate denominator is not stated in the API response.
No refresh cadence is documented in the API response.
